Loss report: gitea -> drone
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/deploy job.environment (Drone has no environment name or URL in the pipeline file)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/deploy job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/deploy job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/deploy/step/deploy-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
